

<style>
#cvw{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
#cvw *{box-sizing:border-box}
.cv-sum{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.cv-st{flex:1;min-width:110px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--r-md,16px);padding:12px 14px}
.cv-st b{display:block;font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cv-st span{font-size:.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.cv-g{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.cv-c{flex:1;min-width:260px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--r-md,16px);padding:13px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.cv-c.si{border-left:3px solid #4ade80}
.cv-c.no{border-left:3px solid #f87171}
.cv-c.pt{border-left:3px solid #fbbf24}
.cv-ch{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px}
.cv-ch h4{margin:0;border:none!important;font-size:.98rem;flex:1}
.cv-ch em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:.68rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);font-weight:400}
.cv-p{font-size:.67rem;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.cv-p.si{background:rgba(74,222,128,.18);color:#4ade80}
.cv-p.no{background:rgba(248,113,113,.18);color:#fca5a5}
.cv-p.pt{background:rgba(251,191,36,.18);color:#fbbf24}
.cv-v{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center}
.cv-v video{width:104px;height:59px;flex:none;background:#000;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover}
.cv-fx{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.cv-r{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:.75rem}
.cv-r span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);white-space:nowrap}
.cv-r b{font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);text-align:right;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.cv-r b.hw{color:var(--accent,#4ade80)}
.cv-sec{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--r-md,16px);padding:15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.cv-sec h4{margin:0;border:none!important;font-size:.98rem}
.cv-hls{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cv-hls video{width:150px;height:84px;background:#000;border-radius:8px}
.cv-imp{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.cv-imp li{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:baseline;font-size:.85rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.cv-imp li i{font-style:normal;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--accent,#4ade80);flex:none;width:56px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.cv-ua{font-size:.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);word-break:break-all;line-height:1.5}
.cv-b{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:var(--r-md,16px);padding:9px 16px;font-size:.82rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;align-self:flex-start}
</style>

<div id="cvw">
<div class="cv-sum" id="cv-sum"></div>
<div class="cv-g" id="cv-g"></div>
<div class="cv-sec">
<h4>HLS nativo</h4>
<div class="cv-hls">
<video id="cv-hv" muted playsinline></video>
<div class="cv-fx" style="min-width:170px">
<div class="cv-r"><span>Reproduce</span><b id="cv-hr">probando</b></div>
<div class="cv-r"><span>canPlayType</span><b id="cv-hc">-</b></div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="font-size:.83rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65)"></div>
</div>
<div class="cv-sec">
<h4>Que significa para el reproductor</h4>
<ul class="cv-imp" id="cv-imp"></ul>
</div>
<div class="cv-sec">
<h4>Este navegador</h4>
<div class="cv-ua" id="cv-ua"></div>
<button class="cv-b" id="cv-cp">Copiar resultados</button>
</div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
const W=document.getElementById('cvw');
if(!W)return;
const $=i=>document.getElementById(i);
const CV_H264='';
const CV_HEVC='';
const CV_VP9='';
const CV_AV1='';
const CV_TS0='';
const CV_TS1='';
const CV_L=[
 {k:'H264',n:'H.264',c:'avc1.42E01E',m:'video/mp4',d:CV_H264},
 {k:'HEVC',n:'HEVC / H.265',c:'hvc1.1.6.L93.B0',m:'video/mp4',d:CV_HEVC},
 {k:'VP9',n:'VP9',c:'vp9',m:'video/webm',d:CV_VP9},
 {k:'AV1',n:'AV1',c:'av01.0.05M.08',m:'video/mp4',d:CV_AV1}
];
const CV_R={},CV_T={si:'Reproduce',no:'No reproduce',pt:'Parcial'};
let urls=[];
function CV_E1(b,t){const s=atob(b),a=new Uint8Array(s.length);
 for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++)a[i]=s.charCodeAt(i);
 const u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([a],{type:t}));urls.push(u);return u;}
function CV_P1(v,src){return new Promise(res=>{
 let f=false;
 const end=(st,d)=>{if(f)return;f=true;clearTimeout(to);res({st,d});};
 v.addEventListener('error',()=>end('no',v.error?'error '+v.error.code:'error'));
 v.addEventListener('loadeddata',()=>{if(!v.videoWidth)end('no','sin imagen');});
 v.addEventListener('timeupdate',()=>{if(v.currentTime>.06&&v.videoWidth>0)end('si',v.videoWidth+'x'+v.videoHeight);});
 const to=setTimeout(()=>{if(v.videoWidth>0)end('pt','carga, no avanza');else end('no','sin respuesta');},12000);
 v.src=src;v.loop=true;const p=v.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{});
});}
async function CV_HW1(m,c){
 if(!navigator.mediaCapabilities||!navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo)return null;
 try{const r=await navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({type:'file',
  video:{contentType:m+'; codecs="'+c+'"',width:1280,height:720,bitrate:2000000,framerate:30}});
  return r.supported?(r.powerEfficient?'hardware':'software'):'no soportado';}catch(e){return null;}
}
function CV_S1(){
 const v=Object.values(CV_R),n=k=>v.filter(x=>x.st===k).length;
 $('cv-sum').innerHTML=
  '<div class="cv-st"><b style="color:#4ade80">'+n('si')+'</b><span>Si</span></div>'+
  '<div class="cv-st"><b style="color:#fca5a5">'+n('no')+'</b><span>No</span></div>'+
  '<div class="cv-st"><b>'+v.filter(x=>x.hw==='hardware').length+'</b><span>hardware</span></div>'+
  '<div class="cv-st"><b>'+v.filter(x=>x.st).length+'/5</b><span>Probados</span></div>';
}
function CV_I1(){
 const g=k=>CV_R[k]&&CV_R[k].st==='si',L=[];
 L.push(['H.264',g('H264')?'T.':'Algo anda mal, ningun navegador actual falla aca.']);
 L.push(['HEVC',g('HEVC')?'TikTok se ve.':'TikTok no , devuelve h265.']);
 L.push(['HLS',g('HLS')?'YouTube se ve sin ayuda, el manifest se reproduce directo.':'YouTube depende de hls.js.']);
 L.push(['Grabar',g('H264')?'.']);
 $('cv-imp').innerHTML=L.map(x=>'<li><i>'+x[0]+'</i><span>'+x[1]+'</span></li>').join('');
}
const pr=document.createElement('video');
$('cv-g').innerHTML=CV_L.map(it=>
 '<div class="cv-c" id="cv-c-'+it.k+'"><div class="cv-ch"><h4>'+it.n+'<em>'+it.c+'</em></h4>'+
 '<span class="cv-p" id="cv-p-'+it.k+'">probando</span></div>'+
 '<div class="cv-v"><video muted playsinline preload="auto" id="cv-v-'+it.k+'"></video><div class="cv-fx">'+
 '<div class="cv-r"><span>Resultado</span><b id="cv-d-'+it.k+'">-</b></div>'+
 '<div class="cv-r"><span>Decodifica</span><b id="cv-h-'+it.k+'">-</b></div>'+
 '<div class="cv-r"><span>canPlayType</span><b id="cv-q-'+it.k+'">-</b></div>'+
 '</div></div></div>').join('');
$('cv-ua').textContent=navigator.userAgent+' | nucleos '+(navigator.hardwareConcurrency||'?')+' | pantalla '+screen.width+'x'+screen.height;
CV_L.forEach(it=>{
 const q=pr.canPlayType(it.m+'; codecs="'+it.c+'"')||'no';
 $('cv-q-'+it.k).textContent=q;
 CV_R[it.k]={n:it.n,q:q};
 CV_HW1(it.m,it.c).then(h=>{
  const e=$('cv-h-'+it.k);
  if(!h){e.textContent='sin dato';return;}
  e.textContent=h;if(h==='hardware')e.className='hw';
  CV_R[it.k].hw=h;CV_S1();});
});
CV_S1();
const jobs=CV_L.map(async it=>{
 const r=await CV_P1($('cv-v-'+it.k),CV_E1(it.d,it.m));
 const c=$('cv-c-'+it.k),p=$('cv-p-'+it.k);
 c.classList.add(r.st);p.className='cv-p '+r.st;p.textContent=CV_T[r.st];
 $('cv-d-'+it.k).textContent=r.d;
 CV_R[it.k].st=r.st;CV_R[it.k].d=r.d;CV_S1();
});
$('cv-hc').textContent=pr.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')||'no';
const u0=CV_E1(CV_TS0,'video/mp2t'),u1=CV_E1(CV_TS1,'video/mp2t');
const pl='#EXTM3U\n#EXT-X-VERSION:3\n#EXT-X-TARGETDURATION:2\n#EXT-X-MEDIA-SEQUENCE:0\n#EXTINF:2.0,\n'+u0+'\n#EXTINF:2.0,\n'+u1+'\n#EXT-X-ENDLIST\n';
const hj=CV_P1($('cv-hv'),URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([pl],{type:'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl'}))).then(r=>{
 $('cv-hr').textContent=CV_T[r.st]+(r.d?' ('+r.d+')':'');
 CV_R.HLS={n:'HLS nativo',st:r.st,d:r.d};CV_S1();});
Promise.all(jobs.concat([hj])).then(()=>{CV_S1();CV_I1();});
$('cv-cp').addEventListener('click',async e=>{
 const t=Object.keys(CV_R).map(k=>{const r=CV_R[k];
  return (r.n||k)+': '+(CV_T[r.st]||'?')+(r.d?' ['+r.d+']':'')+(r.hw?' decodifica='+r.hw:'')+(r.q?' canPlayType='+r.q:'');}).join('\n');
 try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t+'\n\n'+navigator.userAgent);e.target.textContent='Copiado';}
 catch(x){e.target.textContent='No se pudo copiar';}
 setTimeout(()=>{e.target.textContent='Copiar resultados';},2000);
});
function CV_U1(){
 urls.forEach(u=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u));urls=[];
 document.removeEventListener('contentUnload',CV_U1);
}
document.addEventListener('contentUnload',CV_U1);
})();
</script>
